official_tools.label: USDA APHIS: Find an accredited veterinarian (search by state and county)
official_tools.text: The official NVAP search tool. Choose your state and county and Category I (dogs and cats). Not every accredited vet chooses to be listed, so you can also ask your own vet whether someone in the practice is USDA-accredited.

official_tools.label: USDA APHIS: How do I find a USDA-accredited veterinarian?
official_tools.text: Most countries require the health certificate to be issued by a USDA-accredited vet and then endorsed by APHIS. Accreditation is state-specific: the vet must be accredited in the state where you see them.

official_tools.label: USDA APHIS: Take a pet from the US to another country
official_tools.text: Step-by-step export process and each destination country's requirements. Contact an accredited vet as soon as you decide to travel.

official_tools.label: USDA APHIS: Pet travel (all topics)
official_tools.text: Domestic and international pet travel, including which animals count as pets and the CDC rules for dogs.
